prefix_policy: reuse all exact predecessor prompt IDs; no rerendering or new cases
alias_binding: entire prefix unchanged; exactly one appended token; deduplicate by token ID within class; reject cross-class collisions
unique_alias_path_count: sum of distinct within-class alias token IDs across the 144 prefixes; at most 576
path_definition: one fixed alias token followed immediately by the pinned model EOS token
history: teacher-forced complete-prefix recomputation; no KV cache
probability_arithmetic: FP64 log_softmax over the entire native vocabulary; no temperature scaling
start_class_log_mass: logsumexp of all unique same-class alias-token log probabilities at the original prefix
complete_class_log_mass: logsumexp of all unique same-class alias-token log probabilities plus conditional EOS log probabilities at prefix-plus-alias
prediction: class with strictly greater log mass; exact ties are unknown and not correct
conditional_probability: normalize the two class masses only for an explicitly conditional diagnostic; also retain each unnormalized class mass and their total covered mass
coverage: finite four-string path set, not exhaustive whitespace/case/tokenization variants accepted by the whole-answer parser
comparison: paired diagnostic classification versus historical lowercase-only initial choice scores; never rescore or repair the 288 historical generations
initial_parity: exact historical lower-choice native logits and native shared-versus-ordinary full-logit parity on all 144 prefixes
